consent.consent_text: I authorize Demo Toyota Toronto to contact me by phone or email about VIN 2T3R1RFV8RC123456, my requested test drive on October 29, and a possible trade-in of my 2018 Honda Civic. I understand I can withdraw consent at any time.

appointment.notes: I'd like to test the RAV4 and have my Civic appraised in the same visit.

message: I'm interested in the 2024 Toyota RAV4 (VIN 2T3R1RFV8RC123456) advertised for CA$35,500 with 72,000 km. I plan to pay cash and would like to trade in my 2018 Honda Civic with 96,000 km. Please confirm Thursday afternoon for the test drive and trade-in appraisal.
